label: input n echoed in early copy phase (recall 1-3), sparse subset
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, only when the fed-back input token is n, and only early in the copy (recall_idx 1-3, i.e. n was original token 0-2; recall_idx 2 / input two steps after <DEL> has the highest rate and ~70% of mass), mostly in longer sequences (L>=5, rate rising with L). Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, on any other input token, or on n late in the copy. This necessary condition covers ~100% of activation mass, but only ~4% of such steps activate, so precision is very low; the extra selecting factor depends on sequence content and was not captured. Magnitude is largest when the next output is also n (original contains nn: out_tok==n gives 33% of activations, 45% of mass, ~40% precision); other enriched outputs are f, s, y, 1. Repeated tokens (in_count>=2) are mildly enriched.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=2 & in_tok=n (+5.70), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=n (+4.55), recall_idx=3 & in_tok=n (+3.01), phase=2 & in_tok=n (+2.97), phase=2 & out_tok=n (+2.70), out_tok=n (+2.59). Lower it: orig4=- (-1.76), recall_idx=4 (-1.65), orig4=i (-1.43), orig0=v (-1.38).
